<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

The shared DDL boundary is crates/store/src/admin.rs: create_database, drop_database, and drop_database_if_idle take one process-wide tokio semaphore sized from FS3_DB_MUTATION_CONCURRENCY (default 1, max 2), so testkit, store integration support, doctor, and sandbox callers using the API cannot bypass it. FreshDatabase delegates without a second permit. Its create panic distinguishes no listener, authentication/permission rejection, and connected-then-closed/recovery. Orphan listing parses both minted shapes, selects only pg_stat_database rows with numbackends=0, and each sweep drop rechecks liveness under the permit and uses unforced DROP to fail safe on a race. crates/testkit/examples/list_orphans.rs is the read-only production listing seam.

<a id="risks"></a>

## Risks

| id | text |
| --- | --- |
| risk-1 | A process-wide static Semaphore across multiple tokio runtimes (each #[tokio::test] builds its own) — a tokio Semaphore in a static is runtime-agnostic, but verify; std::sync::Mutex held across .await is the trap |
| risk-2 | Serialising creates slows suites that mint many DBs — measure the oversize suite before/after and report; N knob exists for that reason |
| risk-3 | The sweep parser matching too broadly and dropping a non-test database — the shape requires `&lt;epoch&gt;_&lt;32hex&gt;` tail; assert prod-like names (flowspace3, flowspace3_test) are never candidates |
